title: Array
summary: Numbered boxes side by side, like seats in a cinema row.

viz.hello: This array has room for {n} values and size = {size}. Type an index and a value, then try insert, remove, get or search.
viz.needIndex: Type an index first: a box number, starting from 0.
viz.got: get({index}): box {index} holds {value}. The computer goes straight there, no loop.
viz.shiftRight: insert({index}, {value}): {count} values move one box right, starting from the end.
viz.noShift: insert({index}, {value}): this is the end of the array, so nothing has to move.
viz.inserted: {value} is now in box {index}, and size is {size}.
viz.removed: remove({index}): took out {value}. {count} values moved one box left, and size is {size}.
viz.ghost: The faded number is an old copy left behind by the shift. It is past size, so it is not part of the array any more.
viz.found: search({value}): checked {checked} boxes and found it at index {index}.
viz.notFound: search({value}): checked all {checked} boxes. It is not there, so the answer is -1.
viz.errFull: insert({index}, {value}): every box is in use (size = capacity = {n}). The array is full.
viz.errRange: {op}({index}): index out of range. Right now you can use 0 to {max}.
viz.errEmpty: {op}({index}): the array is empty, so there is nothing at any index.
viz.removedLast: remove({index}): took out {value}. It was the last value, so nothing had to move, and size is {size}.
viz.foundFirst: search({value}): found it in the very first box, index {index}.
viz.resetDone: Started again with an empty array.
